STP.note: The document states no data localisation rule.

facts.fact: RSTP states that Sao Tome and Principe approved its general data protection law in 2016 and the law on the organisation and functioning of the data protection authority in 2017.
facts.system: Agencia Nacional de Protecao de Dados Pessoais (ANPDP)

facts.fact: RSTP reports that the ANPDP, headed by director Jose Costa Alegre, held a workshop on 24 April 2026 for its eighth anniversary and is described as the supervisory body.
